signature: SUBROUTINE ZTREVC( SIDE, HOWMNY, SELECT, N, T, LDT, VL, LDVL, VR,

params.name: side
howmny
SELECT
params.reference: If `HOWMNY = 'S'`, `SELECT` specifies the eigenvectors to be computed. The eigenvector corresponding to the j-th eigenvalue is computed if `SELECT(j)` = .TRUE.. Not referenced if `HOWMNY = 'A'` or 'B'.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix T. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The upper triangular matrix T. T is modified, but restored on exit.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: VL
params.reference:
On entry, if `SIDE = 'L'` or 'B' and `HOWMNY = 'B'`, `VL` must contain an N-by-N matrix Q (usually the unitary matrix Q of Schur vectors returned by ZHSEQR). On exit, if `SIDE = 'L'` or 'B', `VL` contains: if `HOWMNY = 'A'`, the matrix Y of left eigenvectors of T; if `HOWMNY = 'B'`, the matrix $Q \, Y$; if `HOWMNY = 'S'`, the left eigenvectors of T specified by

-   `SELECT`, stored consecutively in the columns
-   of `VL`, in the same order as their
-   eigenvalues.

Not referenced if `SIDE = 'R'`.

params.name: ldvl
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VL`. $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge 1$, and if `SIDE = 'L'` or 'B', $\mathrm{LDVL} \ge N$.

params.name: VR
params.reference:
On entry, if `SIDE = 'R'` or 'B' and `HOWMNY = 'B'`, `VR` must contain an N-by-N matrix Q (usually the unitary matrix Q of Schur vectors returned by ZHSEQR). On exit, if `SIDE = 'R'` or 'B', `VR` contains: if `HOWMNY = 'A'`, the matrix X of right eigenvectors of T; if `HOWMNY = 'B'`, the matrix $Q \, X$; if `HOWMNY = 'S'`, the right eigenvectors of T specified by

-   `SELECT`, stored consecutively in the columns
-   of `VR`, in the same order as their
-   eigenvalues.

Not referenced if `SIDE = 'L'`.

params.name: ldvr
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VR`. $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge 1$, and if `SIDE = 'R'` or 'B'; $\mathrm{LDVR} \ge N$.

params.name: mm
params.reference: The number of columns in the arrays `VL` and/or `VR`. $\mathrm{MM} \ge M$.

params.name: m
params.reference: The number of columns in the arrays `VL` and/or `VR` actually used to store the eigenvectors. If `HOWMNY = 'A'` or 'B', M is set to N. Each selected eigenvector occupies one column.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

untranslated: check -11: tests the output argument M (its value is computed, not passed in)
